description.en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

description.zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID。
description.en: The UID of one of the member accounts of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

description.zh: 要删除的VPC边界防火墙的实例ID列表。
description.en: The list of instance IDs of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls to delete.

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于删除VPC边界防火墙。该VPC边界防火墙是防护通过高速通道连接的两个VPC之间流量。
调用本接口前，必须已经调用[CreateVpcFirewallConfigure](~~342893~~)接口创建了VPC边界防火墙。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
This operation is used to delete a virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall that protects traffic between two VPCs connected through Express Connect.
Before you invoke this operation, you must have already created a VPC firewall by invoking the [CreateVpcFirewallConfigure](~~342893~~) operation.

## Rate limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 10 calls per second. If the limit is exceeded, API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation at an appropriate frequency.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw delete-vpc-firewall-configure --lang zh --vpc-firewall-id-list vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --member-uid 2580394279020000 --region cn-hangzhou
